transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Sunday, September 6. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Sooryavanshi faces another big test: his first five-day game in Duleep Trophy final. At just 15, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is set to make his mark in the Duleep Trophy final, playing his inaugural five-day first-class match for East Zone. With a string of impressive achievements including record-breaking performances in the IPL and his international debut, this match will test his versatility and endurance, pushing him to adapt to the demands of longer cricket formats. US immigration authority denies, revokes multiple H-1B petitions from major IT firm. USCIS denied and revoked multiple H-1B visa petitions from a major IT consulting company. The agency found skilled technology jobs were classified at lower wage levels than supported. This practice undercuts required wages and creates unfair competition for American workers. USCIS stated its action protects American workers and maintains program integrity. Canadian billionaire Kevin O'Leary says success requires sacrifice, focus and obsession. Kevin O'Leary emphasizes that reaching peak success requires immense dedication and sacrifice. He recommends that individuals focus on three to five key priorities while steering clear of distractions. Influential figures like Mark Cuban and Elon Musk echo similar sentiments, highlighting the role of sacrifice in amassing wealth. O'Leary cautions entrepreneurs to acknowledge failures swiftly, as pouring more resources into failing ideas rarely leads to redemption. Those who put India in Fragile 5 doubting GDP: PM Modi. NEW DELHI: PM Modi Saturday lashed out at critics questioning positive developments in the country, including the robust growth in GDP, on his govt's watch as congenital pessimists and fault-finders, asserting the "power of truth" will eventually overwhelm the "campaign of lies". CIL offers extra fuel, 57 plants now report critically low stock. NEW DELHI: State-run Coal India Limited (CIL) has offered power plants having fuel supply agreements with it and its subsidiaries to lift additional quantities of coal, over and above the quantities stipulated in their annual contracts, as stocks available at thermal power plants fell further. Father spends $800,000 on land for tiny-home community for disabled adults. Dave Curro is spearheading the development of Forest Grove, an innovative community designed specifically for adults with special needs. This initiative will include 20 tiny homes and a supporting community center, providing essential resources. A recent festival raised significant funds, demonstrating strong community support. Curro's son, Bret, inspires this heartfelt project, addressing a crucial shortage in housing options for this underserved population. Putin, US envoys hold 3-hour talks on Ukraine with no breakthrough. Russian president Vladimir Putin held more than three hours of "highly useful" talks on Saturday with two US envoys seeking a deal to end the Ukraine war, a Kremlin aide said, but gave no indication of any breakthrough. Michigan seed experiment began in 1879 and is set to run until 2100. In a remarkable exploration of seed dormancy, William James Beal's 1879 experiment revealed astonishing results when researchers discovered viable seeds in 2021, 142 years later. This included a surprising hybrid moth mullein detected through DNA analysis, enriching the study's findings. Insights gained will enhance land restoration efforts and help control invasive species for a sustainable future, demonstrating the enduring legacy of scientific inquiry. With bare hands, lone warrior 'Bittu Tabahi' cleans up dumpyard of a river. BHOPAL: His online followers know him as 'Bittu Tabahi'. 10 days after Nepal flash floods, woman, Chinese man rescued. KATHMANDU: Two people were rescued alive from separate flood-hit sites on Saturday, 10 days after Bhote Koshi-Trishuli flood in Nepal. Tiger Woods and Vanessa Trump build wealth through brands and real estate. Vanessa Trump's wealth stems from family investments and real estate holdings. Tiger Woods built a diverse business empire through golf and various ventures. Woods' TGR Ventures oversees golf course design and sports entertainment projects. His portfolio includes fashion, hospitality, and technology investments. Aadhaar for rest, but babus resist link for CGHS. Over 3,100 DBT schemes and 360 public services use Aadhaar-based authentication.
